h1: Rapeepan Ville Hotel — a quiet little hotel near Ubon airport with rooms cleaner than the price suggests
intro: If you are flying into Ubon and want somewhere quiet, clean and gentle on the wallet close to the airport, Rapeepan Ville Hotel is a name guests mention often — a small boutique hotel of around 28 rooms tucked down a quiet soi in Ubon, decorated in a contemporary Thai style, with rooms that are spotless and very quiet · There is a Thai restaurant, a small garden and free parking · It scores a high 9.4 on Trip.com and ranks near the top of Ubon's guesthouses on TripAdvisor · From approx ฿800/night.

body.html: The first thing guests mention about Rapeepan Ville Hotel is how clean and quiet it is · It is a small building of around 28 rooms tucked down Sukha Uppatham soi, set back a little from the main road, so there is none of the traffic noise you get at roadside hotels · Reviews repeatedly call the corridors, lobby, restaurant and rooms spotless — a small hotel that is genuinely well looked after, the kind of place where you sleep well and wake up fresh.

Location is the main draw · The hotel is close to Ubon Ratchathani Airport (UBP), about 5 km away or roughly a 12-minute drive, and there is an airport shuttle for a fee · A few minutes' walk brings you to a convenience store and a supermarket · It is about 3 km from the city centre and Thung Si Muang, a short drive · That makes it a strong pick for travellers flying in and out of Ubon, or arriving by car and wanting free parking somewhere peaceful.
"The room was very clean and so quiet, with slippers and good air conditioning, the staff were friendly and helpful and the breakfast was tasty — superb value for a small hotel in Ubon."

Rooms are decorated in a contemporary Thai style, ranging from Deluxe Double and Deluxe Twin up to Premier and Grand Premier · Guests consistently praise that the rooms are clean, get good natural light and some have a balcony, with a TV, fridge/minibar and a bathroom with a water heater, shower, slippers and toiletries · The on-site restaurant serves Thai food, both in-room and at an outdoor dining area, and a buffet breakfast is available for a fee (around ฿150), which many guests describe as tasty.

To be straight about it, this is not a luxury hotel and there are limits worth knowing before booking · There is no swimming pool, and as a building renovated back in 2015, some rooms show a little wear with age · A few reviews note that the rooms are not very soundproof, so you may hear next-door noise · As a small hotel, the facilities are limited — the focus is on cleanliness and quiet rather than resort-style amenities.

The scores back up the picture · Rapeepan Ville earns around 9.4 on Trip.com from 41 reviews and roughly 4.5 stars on TripAdvisor, ranking near the top of Ubon's guesthouse/B&B category · That is unusually high for a small, low-priced hotel, and it reflects genuine satisfaction with the cleanliness, the quiet and the friendly service.

In short, Rapeepan Ville Hotel is a small, quiet, clean hotel near Ubon airport at a gentle price · It suits travellers flying in and out of Ubon, here for a short errand, or arriving by car wanting free parking somewhere peaceful · If you expect a pool, full facilities or a walkable city-centre location, this may not be the fit · But if you want a clean room, a good night's sleep, close to the airport and good value, this is a solid choice.

A tip from following the reviews: if you are a light sleeper, ask for an upper floor or a room not adjoining another, as the rooms are not very soundproof · If you are flying in, give your flight time in advance to book the airport shuttle · And do try the in-house breakfast — many guests say it is tasty and worth the ฿150.

faqTitle: Frequently Asked Questions — Rapeepan Ville Hotel Ubon Ratchathani

faq.q: Where is Rapeepan Ville Hotel and how do I get there?
faq.a: It is on Sukha Uppatham soi in Nai Mueang, near Ubon Ratchathani Airport (UBP) · The airport is about 5 km away, roughly a 12-minute drive · A convenience store and supermarket are a few minutes' walk away · The city centre and Thung Si Muang are about 3 km, around a 10-minute drive.

faq.q: How much does Rapeepan Ville Hotel cost and what rooms are there?
faq.a: Rates start at approximately ฿800/night for a Deluxe Double · A Deluxe Twin is around ฿850, a Premier Room around ฿1,100, and the largest Grand Premier from around ฿1,800 · Prices vary by season and city events, so compare a few platforms before booking.

faq.q: Does Rapeepan Ville Hotel have a pool and an airport shuttle?
faq.a: There is no swimming pool · It is a small hotel focused on cleanliness and quiet rather than facilities · There is an airport shuttle for a fee and free parking · The on-site Thai restaurant serves meals, and a buffet breakfast is available for around ฿150 extra.

faq.q: What are the rooms like and are they clean?
faq.a: Rooms are in a contemporary Thai style — clean, with good natural light and some with a balcony, plus a TV, fridge, slippers and a bathroom with a water heater · Guests praise the cleanliness and the quiet most of all · The main limits are that the rooms are not very soundproof and the building was renovated back in 2015.

faq.q: Who is Rapeepan Ville Hotel best for?
faq.a: It suits travellers flying in and out of Ubon who want a quiet, clean, well-priced room near the airport, or drivers wanting free parking somewhere peaceful · It is not ideal for those who want a pool, full facilities, or a walkable city-centre tourist location.

faq.q: What are Rapeepan Ville Hotel's review scores?
faq.a: It earns around 9.4 on Trip.com from 41 reviews and roughly 4.5 stars on TripAdvisor, near the top of Ubon's guesthouse/B&B category · Most guests are happy with the cleanliness, the quiet and the friendly service.
